collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — PONDERING HOW LIFE HAS GONE (LIF-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Adults of every age looking at their own lives so far: roads not taken, quiet satisfaction, small regrets, unexpected pride, things left unfinished, luck, gratitude and plenty of amusement. Nobody has to reach a verdict.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult aged 45 or older and another adult)

collection.description: The council adopts a villager's idea from twenty years ago without remembering it: remind them, or enjoy it privately.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Twenty years ago, (subject) told everyone that the canoe landing should be moved to the sheltered side of the point. Everyone said no. (subject.He/she) was outvoted, ignored, and teased about it for a season. Today, the council has just decided to move the canoe landing to the sheltered side of the point. Nobody has mentioned that it was (subject)'s idea. Nobody remembers.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) stands up at the fire and says, very calmly, "I suggested that twenty years ago." There's a silence. A few elders look sheepish. One says, "Did you?" Another says, "...Oh. You did." (friend) bursts out laughing. (subject) sits down, enormously satisfied. The landing is moved. A small carving appears on the new post: "(subject) said so first."

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) says nothing. (subject.He/she) just smiles, very slightly, all through the meeting. Afterward (friend) asks why (subject.he/she) looks so pleased. "No reason," says (subject). (subject.He/she) walks home in the moonlight, grinning like a child. Being right twenty years too late, all by (subject.him/her)self, turns out to be one of the best feelings (subject.he/she) has ever had.
